subject: English
title: 英文第33題｜依去年今年明年還原航線
question:
What might be the flight routes last year?
(A) 圖A
(B) 圖B
(C) 圖C
(D) 圖D
explanation:
一、先分清三個時間
北Daisy—Lily在「今年3月」才開航，因此去年不能有這條線。明年再新增Lily—Rose、南Daisy—Rose兩條線，去年也不能有它們。

二、由原圖倒推
先從未來路網去掉今年新增的北Daisy—Lily，再去掉明年兩條標New航線。留下去年既有的北Daisy—南Daisy、北Daisy—Rose，對應圖D。

三、排除其餘路網
A仍含北Daisy—Lily等較晚開通航線；B保留Lily連線與南Daisy—Rose，不合去年；C同樣保留今年才開的北Daisy—Lily。D的Lily沒有航線連接，才與開航時間一致。不能把題幹last year看成this year或next year。
verificationNote: 已實開真正上傳原卷及本題裁切，逐項核對完整題幹、四選項與必要閱讀文章／圖表。未提供實際考試日期，採本題首次對話的台灣日期。無可靠冊次或課次證據，歸綜合。 原卷證據以白邊分隔拼接共同材料與本題，省略未提問的旁題；未重繪原卷。
studentAnswer: 使用者原始紀錄：33@錯題C → D；原筆跡保留於下方原卷。

passage:
If you plan to travel between the small islands, you will be interested in the following news. After the flight between Northern Daisy Island and Lily Island started in March this year, there will be two more flight routes next year.

One flight route is between Lily Island and Rose Island. You can travel between the two islands without going back to Northern Daisy Island first. The other new route starting next year is between Southern Daisy Island and Rose Island. Instead of taking a sea bus for more than five hours, you can spend much less time flying between the two islands. It will be much more convenient for you because it saves both time and money.

To have more people experience the new flight to Rose Island, the tickets during the first three months of next year will be on sale online. The price may be up to 40% off. If you plan to have a vacation and enjoy the famous hot springs on Rose Island, don't forget to book the tickets as soon as possible.

原卷詞註：flight 航班；route 路線；instead 代替。
原圖標示Northern Daisy Island、Southern Daisy Island、Lily Island、Rose Island；紅點與連線表示Flight routes，New標示新航線，完整路網見下方作答附圖。
